Definition: a cry, i.e. (of grief) a lamentation
BiblicalUsage: marzêach is a cry of grief, a lamentation, and it occurs once, in Jeremiah 16:5. There the LORD tells Jeremiah not to enter the house of mourning, nor to lament or bemoan them, for He has taken away His peace from this people, even lovingkindness and mercies. The word is the wailing that God forbids.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe marzêach shows me that God can forbid even mourning when judgment falls, and that His peace taken away is the deepest grief of all.
